name: Liam Neeson Taken
look: A dark film still of Liam Neeson in a black sweater holding a phone to his ear and speaking with a stern, intense stare. Thick black letterbox bars run across the top and bottom of the square image.
use: Parodies the famous phone threat. The top caption starts like "I don't know who you are..." and the bottom ends with "but I will find you, and I will..." plus something harmless or petty, like thanking them.
slots: the setup, often "I don't know who you are" (top)
the twist on "I will find you" (bottom)
examples: I don't know who you are, but you returned my lost wallet
I will find you, and I will bake you cookies
To whoever ate my labeled lunch from the office fridge
I will find you, and I will label it louder
